r: dnf-kpatch is a dnf(8) plugin providing automated installation of kpatch-patch packages. When enabled, installation of new kernel packages via dnf(8) will trigger installation of the latest kpatch-patch package targeting the same kernel version.

operation
auto-update, auto
Installs missing kpatch-patch packages for installed kernels and enables their automatic installation for future kernel updates.
manual-update, manual
Disables automatic installation of kpatch-patch packages.
auto-filter
Shows only the kernel packages in the DNF database that have a kpatch-patch counterpart.
no-filter
Shows all available kernel packages, including those that do not have a kpatch-patch counterpart.
install
Installs missing kpatch-patch packages for installed kernels.
status
Queries the current installation setting of dnf-kpatch.
To report a bug, raise an issue on kpatch-dnf project page.
